name: HealthRoute Loop 01: Medical Courier Outreach & Dispatch (WF-LT005-ACQUIRE)

parameters.jsCode:
// HealthRoute Charlotte Facilities Queue
const items = $input.all();
const incoming = items[0]?.json?.body || items[0]?.json;

if (incoming && incoming.name && incoming.contact_email) {
  return [{
    json: {
      id: incoming.id || 'manual-' + Date.now(),
      name: incoming.name,
      facility_type: incoming.facility_type || 'hospital',
      address: incoming.address || 'Charlotte, NC',
      contact_email: incoming.contact_email,
      contact_phone: incoming.contact_phone || '704-555-0100',
      decision_maker_name: incoming.decision_maker_name || 'Medical Director',
      decision_maker_title: incoming.decision_maker_title || 'Director of Clinical Logistics',
      specialty: incoming.specialty || 'STAT specimen transport',
      source: 'webhook_inbound'
    }
  }];
}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ statements: [{ statement: 'MERGE (f:Facility {name: $name}) ON CREATE SET f.id = $id, f.type = $facility_type, f.email = $email, f.city = "Charlotte", f.state = "NC" MERGE (o:OutreachAttempt {campaign: $campaign, timestamp: $dispatched_at}) SET o.subject = $subject, o.status = "dispatched", o.expected_revenue = $expected_revenue, o.model = $model MERGE (f)-[:RECEIVED_OUTREACH]->(o) WITH f, o MATCH (v:Venture {id: "LT-005"}) MERGE (v)-[:LOGGED_OUTREACH]->(o) RETURN o.status', parameters: { name: $json.facility_name, id: $json.facility_id, facility_type: $json.facility_type, email: $json.recipient_email, campaign: $json.campaign, dispatched_at: $json.dispatched_at, subject: $json.subject, expected_revenue: $json.expected_revenue, model: $json.model_used } }] }) }}
